text: Contract: The Enlightened is created with Inscription (101); taught by Technique: Contract: The Enlightened.
Consumed by Rage is a Warrior rune for pants. It is learned from Rune of Consuming Rage.
Contained Void Samples are looted from Titan Chests in Thaldraszus.
Controlled Current Technique drops from Kurog Grimtotem in the Vault of the Incarnates.
Contract: Arificer Romuul is not available. It would have recruited Artificer Romuul as a garrison follower. In the live game, he is instead recruited via a quest.
Contract: Dream Wardens is created with Dragon Isles Inscription (25); taught by Technique: Contract: Dream Wardens.
Contamination Guards are refti located in Sulfur Wastes in Zaralek Cavern.
The Contested Pass is a subzone found east of Ar'gorok in the Arathi Highlands in the Plunderstorm.
Contaminating Cleaver drops from Rotfist at the Tranquil Strand on the Isle of Dorn.
Construct Competitors are Maldraxxi abominations fought in the Theater of Pain in Maldraxxus during the start of the Maldraxxus storyline.
Consuming Voidstones are skardyn located in the Abandoned Mines in the Rookery.
The Construct Orb is found near Caldoran in . Activating it boosts the health and damage of all creatures within Naxxramas and applies while within the Construct Quarter.

Contract: The Cartels of Undermine is created with Khaz Algar Inscription (35); taught by Technique: Contract: The Cartels of Undermine. Amount of reputation gained depends on the quality of the item.

The Construct of Soridormi is an image created by Soridormi to help adventurers in the Horrific Visions Revisited. She can be summoned or dismissed via the Bronze Hourglass in the vision preparation room. When active, she counts as an additional party member and will affect enemies' health scaling.
Contract: Assembly of the Deeps is created with Khaz Algar Inscription (35); taught by Technique: Contract: Assembly of the Deeps. Amount of reputation gained depends on the quality of the item.
Contract: Hallowfall Arathi is created with Khaz Algar Inscription (35); taught by Technique: Contract: Hallowfall Arathi. Amount of reputation gained depends on the quality of the item.
Contract: The Severed Threads is created with Khaz Algar Inscription (35); taught by Technique: Contract: The Severed Threads. Amount of reputation gained depends on the quality of the item.
Contract: Council of Dornogal is created with Khaz Algar Inscription (35); taught by Technique: Contract: Council of Dornogal. Amount of reputation gained depends on the quality of the item.
Construction Haulbots are haulbots located in Lothar's Landing in Hallowfall.
Consumed Wastelander's Epaulets drop from Azhiccar in Eco-Dome Al'dani.
Control Console V-37 is a console found in Eco-Dome: Primus in K'aresh. It has to be stabilized in Eco-Stabilizing.
Control Console Z-22 is a console found in Eco-Dome: Primus in K'aresh. It has to be stabilized in Eco-Stabilizing.
Control Console D-28 is a console found in Eco-Dome: Primus in K'aresh. It has to be stabilized in Eco-Stabilizing.

Container of Highly Profitable Sludge is looted during the Black Blood Profits story variant of Excavation Site 9. They contribute 8-10% of the "Generate Profits!" bar and can be found throughout the delve or surrounding a Profit M.A.X.-Miner 9000 after it finishes drilling.
Control Console J-07 is a console found in Eco-Dome: Primus in K'aresh.
The Contained Essence of Dread teaches you how to summon Dread, a manifestation companion. It drops from Eternas the Tormentor in the Maw.
Contracts of Service are looted from the corpses of players in Slayer's Rise.
Contraband Sniffers are hyenas located in Slam Central Station and Hovel Hill in Undermine. They accompany Hyena Handlers. A cub with the title is running around.

Construct Soldiers are Maldraxxi abominations that spawn at the Bleak Redoubt in Maldraxxus during In Death We Are Truly Tested. Dead ones are also found at the House of the Chosen during Among the Chosen.
Construct Commanders are Maw casters found at Cocyrus and Zovaal's Cauldron in the Maw during a Kyrian Assault.
Contract: The Amani Tribe is a contract created with Midnight Inscription (35); taught by Technique: Contract: The Amani Tribe.
Contract: The Hara'ti is a contract created with Midnight Inscription (35); taught by Technique: Contract: The Hara'ti.
Contract: The Singularity is a contract created with Midnight Inscription (35); taught by Technique: Contract: The Singularity.
Construct Surgeons are Maldraxxi necromancers found at the House of Constructs in Maldraxxus during Abombing Run.
Consuming Upswells are fire elementals found at the Melting Knoll in the Waking Shores during Wash Over Them.
Contract: Zul'jarra's Forces is a contract created with Midnight Inscription (50); taught by Technique: Contract: Zul'jarra's Forces.
Content Ducklings are ducks found in the Ohn'ahran Plains and the Waking Shores during Cataloging world quests.
Continue Your Training continues the Forsaken paladin questing experience based out of Deathknell in . At level 8, she continues the paladin questline with A Second Home.
Copper Scarab Bulwark is available for purchase at the Trading Post for 400 Trader's Tender.

Copper Resonating Crystal teaches the Jeweled Copper Scarab, a beetle mount. It can be purchased at the Trading Post from the Creatures and Toys Outlet vendor for 500 Trader's Tender. Its original price was 800 Trader's Tender.
Core Hounds are a melee ground unit of the family in Warcraft Rumble. A squad of core hounds is made up of two members.
Cord of Zandalari Resolve is a Battle of Dazar'alor zone drop.
Cord of Bloody Evangelism is a quest reward from Just for Safekeeping, Of Course.
Cord of Aquanis drops from Baron Aquanis in Blackfathom Deeps.
Copper Blood Coins can be used to purchase items from Mai'zin near the Gurubashi Arena in . 100 of them can also be converted into a Silver Blood Coin.

Copper Cannon is available for purchase for 500 Plunder from the Plunderstore during Plunderstorm. In the first iteration of the event, it was rewarded to players who reached renown 8 with Keg Leg's Crew. The appearance can be used in both retail as well as Plunderstorm.
Cord of the Untamed is sold by the Shadowtooth Emissary in for .
Copper Diver's Wrist Seal can be purchased at the Trading Post from the Collections Outlet vendor 10 Trader's Tender.
Copper Diver's Gloves can be purchased at the Trading Post from the Collections Outlet vendor 30 Trader's Tender. Its original price was 60 Trader's Tender.
Copper Diver's Boots is available for purchase at the Trading Post for 60 Trader's Tender.
Copper Diver's Greaves can be purchased at the Trading Post from the Collections Outlet vendor 40 Trader's Tender. Its original price was 80 Trader's Tender.
Copper Diver's Belt can be purchased at the Trading Post from the Collections Outlet vendor 30 Trader's Tender. Its original price was 60 Trader's Tender.
Copper Diver's Corselet can be purchased at the Trading Post from the Collections Outlet vendor 40 Trader's Tender. Its original price was 80 Trader's Tender.
Copper Diver's Pauldrons can be purchased at the Trading Post from the Collections Outlet vendor 60 Trader's Tender. Its original price was 130 Trader's Tender.
Copper Diver's Bonnet can be purchased at the Trading Post from the Collections Outlet vendor for 100 Trader's Tender. Its original price was 220 Trader's Tender.
Convergence concludes the Earthen Fissures chapter of the Isle of Dorn storyline. The campaign continues with Group Effort.
Cord of the Horned Nightmare is an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Regalia of the Horned Nightmare#Mythic.
Cord of the Thousandfold Hells is an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Regalia of the Thousandfold Hells#Raid Finder.
Cord of the Ternion Glory is an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Regalia of Ternion Glory#Raid Finder.
Cord of the Exorcist is an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Regalia of the Exorcist#Raid Finder.
Cord of the Chromatic Hydra is an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Regalia of the Chromatic Hydra#Heroic.
Cord of the Burning Scroll is an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Regalia of the Burning Scroll#Raid Finder.
Copper Massacre Coins can be used to purchase items from Mai'zin near the Gurubashi Arena in . 100 of them can also be converted into a Silver Massacre Coin.
Copper Diver's Tank can be purchased at the Trading Post from the Collections Outlet vendor for 100 Trader's Tender. Its original price was 160 Trader's Tender.

It allows a player to copy an existing retail character to the testing server. The button to access the UI is usually found on the character selection screen, next to the "Enter World" button.
Coolfin Crabtenders are gorlocs located on the beast east of the Tranquil Strand‎ on the Isle of Dorn. They are in mutual benefit with Hagenbran. They sometimes attack.

Cord of the Earthbreaker drops from the Disturbed Earthgorger in the Obsidian Hollow in the Ringing Deeps.

]] Copious Coffers is a delve achievement earned by opening 250 Bountiful Coffers with Restored Coffer Keys. Elise Starseeker sends players some in-game mail after earning the achievement: The Silver Coffer Key is attached.

Cord of Ten Storms is part of the Eruption of the Ten Storms set, the Tier 2 armor set for Elemental Shamans. It can be purchased from Victor Nefriendius in with Ancient Belt (Season of Discovery). It can be traded to Duke Hydraxis in the for a "" version, which has the same stats but is part of the Earthfury Eruption set.

Cord of Transcendence is part of the Twilight of Transcendence set, the Tier 2 DPS armor set for Priests. It can be purchased from Victor Nefriendius in with Draconian Belt. It can be traded to Duke Hydraxis in the for a "" version, which has the same stats but is part of the Twilight Prophecy set.
Coppers the Kobold is sold by Gnawbles at Gundargaz in the Ringing Deeps for 1 Firelight Ruby.
Copper-Maned Quilen Reins teach the Copper-Maned Quilen mount. This item can be purchased for 5,000 from Mistweaver Xia on the Timeless Isle during Mists of Pandaria timewalking events.

Conveyor Slayer is awarded to players who defeat Sprocketmonger Lockenstock without being struck by Blazing Beam, Rocket Barrage, Mega Magnetize, Jumbo Void Beam, or Void Barrage in the Liberation of Undermine on Normal difficulty or higher. This is a solo achievement and is not affected by other players in the raid, and is one of the criteria of Glory of the Liberation of Undermine Raider.
Coolant Core is looted from Heat-Beater 2001 in the Undermine. Pamsy wants one for The Thingamajig.
The Coralscale Salamanther is a salamanther mount rewarded by the Into the Storm meta-achievement.

Coral Nautic Helm can be found in kobyss delve treasure room chests. This item can also be purchased for 2,600 Resonance Crystals from Reno Jackson or drop from Nexus-Princess Ky'veza in delves. From The War Within Season 1 to Season 3, this item can be purchased for 2,500 Undercoin from Sir Finley Mrrgglton.

Core Alloy is a bar crafting reagent made with and used extensively in Khaz Algar Blacksmithing. Blacksmiths can learn how to make this item by learning it from Khaz Algar Blacksmithing trainers such as Darean in Dornogal for .

Cooldown Manager (also Essential Cooldowns) allows a player to track their important cooldowns and buffs in a customizable element. It is not enabled by default but can be enabled in the Options under the "Advanced Options" section.
Cord of Torment is an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Armor of Torment.

Cool Sunset Bracers is created with Khaz Algar Tailoring. The crafting recipe automatically learned after putting 10 points into the Duskweaving sub-subspecialization (From Dawn Until Dusk ⮞ Duskweave Tailoring ⮞ Duskweaving ).
Coordinator Xy'thir is a broker located in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market in K'aresh.
Copper Lapbug is lapbug that can be found in the Wriggling Pinnacle Cache from Ecological Succession (world quest), the weekly wrapper quest for dealing with the Oasis for Ecological Succession.
Copper Pot Lid is available for purchase at the Trading Post for 60 Trader's Tender.
Copper Pot of Stew is available for purchase at the Trading Post for 60 Trader's Tender.
Coral-Pocked Scrying Stone is looted from Seafarer's Caches on Siren Isle.
Cord of the First Oath is a quest reward from Of Bonds and Boughs.
Cooking at Midnight is a profession achievement earned by obtaining 100 skill points in Midnight Cooking. It rewards the Midnight Cook's Shop Sign decor.
Convalescent Carrion is a hex eagle mount rewarded by Midnight Keystone Legend: Season One, which requires reaching a Mythic+ Rating of 3000 during Midnight Season 1.
Cooking Spirits are a crafting reagent used in several dishes from Midnight Cooking. It is sold by the following vendors for .
Corbin Branbell is a Gilnean housing decor vendor found in Bradensbrook in Val'sharah.
Copper Dye was a housing dye used to color certain housing decor. It could be crafted by alchemists or scribes via Dye Crafting with 1 Orange Dye Pigment.

Corby's Cabana Bar and Grill are bars found around Grudge Grotto in Mmarl in Azj-Kahet. They belong to Corby Taps and her Corby's Cabana Co. She wants to expand it all over Azeroth, to every Venture Company branch.
Coralfang's Hefty Fin drops from Coralfang in Eversong Woods.
Coral Scuttlers are crabs found along the beach at the Shimmering Shallows in Stormsong Valley.
Cookie's Special Flavors drop from Cookie in the Deadmines during Classic Timewalking.
Copper Stormsong Well is housing decor purchased from Caspian in Stormsong Valley for .
Coral Shard can be pickpocketed from Darkspine naga and Tideborne smugglers.
Copse Hopskippers are rabbits found in northern Ohn'ahran Plains.
Corked Drakonid Vial drops from Doomshadow in the Azure Span.
Corroded Augari Defender is available for purchase at the Trading Post for 200 Trader's Tender.
Corroded G-7 C.O.R.E. Processor drops from Techbot near the Workshop Door in Gnomeregan in . It begins the quest The Corroded Core.
The Corrupt Moderate Manifestation of Earth appears when drinking the Murky Earth Sapta at the spirit rock on Southbreak Shore in . Defeating it will spawn the Moderate Manifestation of Earth.
The Corrupt Moderate Manifestation of Water appears when drinking the Murky Water Sapta at the spirit rock near the Southfury River in . Defeating it will spawn the Moderate Manifestation of Water.
The Corrupt Moderate Manifestation of Air appears when drinking the Murky Air Sapta at the spirit rock near Skull Rock in the . Defeating it will spawn the Moderate Manifestation of Air.
The Corrupt Moderate Manifestation of Fire appears when drinking the Murky Fire Sapta at the spirit rock outside Blackchar Cave in the . Defeating it will spawn the Moderate Manifestation of Fire.
Corrosive Droplets are water elementals located in Blackfathom Deeps.
Corrosive Blackblood Ring is a quest reward from Fear the Old Blood.
Coreway Repair Rigs are ironstriders located at the Coreway in Dornogal.
Coreway Workers are earthen located around the Coreway in Dornogal.
Cornerdwellers are rats located in Dornogal. They are often found near Mousers and other unfortunate Felled Cornerdwellers.
Coreway Billets have a chance to drop from mobs summoned by Disturbed Earths and can be looted from treasure chests in Khaz Algar.
Cornerstone of Dornogal is a reputation achievement earned by reaching rank 25 with the Council of Dornogal.
The Corridors connect various districts of Dornogal. The Kindling Parlor and the Cinderside Hall can be found here.
Corpse Birds are vultures found in the Codex of Chromie. Some of them are summoned by Brackenhide Blackfeathers during combat.
Corroded Plaque is found by the entrance to the Salt and Shanty in the Ghoststone Diggings on the Siren Isle.
Correspondence from Zirdo is a note written by Zirdo which can be dropped from Gozzic Cogcrane. Renzik "The Shiv" is looking for it in Avenge Them

The Coreway Engineer's Forceps are a cosmetic item that can be obtained through fishing in Khaz Algar. They have a very small chance of being caught in both open water and in pools, such as the Glimmerpool and Calm Surfacing Ripple.
Coreforged Skeleton Key is made with Khaz Algar Blacksmithing; taught by Plans: Coreforged Skeleton Key.
Corpse Cleaner is a consumable item for combat that can be obtained from from Mislaid Curiosities throughout delves or a Heavy Trunk, a Bountiful Heavy Trunk, or the Nemesis Strongbox at the end.
Coreway Sledgehammer can be fished up from the waters in and around the zones of Khaz Algar but can most often be found from Whispers of the Deep, Floating Deep Treasure, and Shore Treasure.
Coreway Pickaxe can be fished up from the waters in and around the zones of Khaz Algar but can most often be found from Whispers of the Deep, Floating Deep Treasure, and Shore Treasure fishing pools.
Coreway Shovel can be fished up from the waters in and around the zones of Khaz Algar but can most often be found from Whispers of the Deep, Floating Deep Treasure, and Shore Treasure.

Coreway Engineer's Screwdriver can be fished up from the waters in and around the zones of Khaz Algar but can most often be found from Whispers of the Deep, Floating Deep Treasure, and Shore Treasure.

Coreforged Repair Hammer is created with Khaz Algar Blacksmithing. The crafting recipe is can be learned from Blacksmithing trainers located in Khaz Algar upon reaching skill level 5 in Khaz Algar Blacksmithing.
Cornelian Divination Techniques is a book located near Procrastimond in Elsewhen.
Corroded Pocket Watch is a trash item that be fished up in Khaz Algar.
Corestones of Patience are unbound earth elementals that can be found at the Staidridge in Deepholm. They drop no loot.

Cornerstones are signs and pillars found at housing plots all over Founder's Point and Razorwind Shores. The signs mark plots for sale, while the pillars mark owned plots. Interacting with a Cornerstone will open a window with information about the plot: *For unowned plots, this includes the plot number, price, neighborhood name, neighborhood type, and which of the two zones it's in. This window is where the plot can be purchased. *For owned plots, this includes the owner, plot number, and neighborhood name. A cogwheel in the top right gives the option to report the plot.
Corrupt, Dominate, Banish drops on the ground from Sethekk Neophytes after engaging them in combat in the Ruins of Kra'nak in Tanaan Jungle. It's propaganda detailing warlock spells.
Corespark Multitool drops from Chief Corewright Kasreth in Nexus-Point Xenas.
Corewright's Zappers drop from Chief Corewright Kasreth in Nexus-Point Xenas.
Corewarden Cuffs drop from Corewarden Nysarra in Nexus-Point Xenas.
Corrosive Felhounds are felhounds that spawn in the Assault on Violet Hold.
Corpse Rind is looted from the Sporeglider Bloomterror near the waterfall in Nai'theren Grotto in Harandar.

The Corked Bottle of Liquid Mystery is a housing decor available from a Fanta promotion from 1 April to 30 July 2026. Players can participate and claim rewards by playing one of the select games on the website with a mobile device without the need to purchase anything. Players have a choice of choosing one reward each week and can claim the rewards by connecting their Coca-Cola account with the Battle.net account. Additional copies can be purchased from Gabbi, Tuuran, or Dennia Silvertongue for .

Corked Bottles of Liquid Mystery refer to the following housing decor, available from a Fanta promotion from 1 April to 30 July 2026. *Short Corked Bottle of Liquid Mystery *Corked Bottle of Liquid Mystery *Tall Corked Bottle of Liquid Mystery
Corewright Arcanists are ethereals located in Nexus-Point Xenas.
Core Technicians are ethereals located in Nexus-Point Xenas.
Corporeal Evaluators are Maldraxxi necromancers found at the Separation Chamber in Maldraxxus.
Corrosive Gorm are gorm that spawn when a player approaches a Decayed Husk in Ardenweald.
Coreway Sentinel Lamppost is housing decor obtained as a quest reward from On the Road. Additional copies can be purchased from Chert in the Ringing Deeps for .

Corrosive Cache is housing decor purchased from Skull of Er'inye in Vaults of Atal'Utek for 2500 Corrosive Coin.
The Core Transport Automa is a geomental that spawns after defeating Lihuvim at the Keeper's Bastion in the Sepulcher of the First Ones.
Corrosive Writhling is sold by Skull of Er'inye in Vaults of Atal'Utek for 5000 .

Corrosive Bilespear is a curio for Valeera Sanguinar during Midnight Season 2. The baseline version is found in low-tier delves, and higher-rank versions are found in higher-tier delves, all the way up to the Rank 4 version in Tier 8 delves. Rank 5 can be obtained from the Labyrinth of Kindo'jan after reaching rank 1 in Kindo'jan's Labyrinth Journey.
Corrosive Relic is provided by Jan'sari the Watchful for Spirit Corrosion.
Corrosive Bijou is provided by Jan'sari the Watchful for More Spirit Corrosion.
Corroded Hulk's Skullcap drops from Kith'ix in the Unbinding of Kith'ix.

Corrosive Coins are found within the Vaults of Atal'Utek. They can be turned in to Er'inye to obtain a Spirit Corrosion point to spend at the Altar of Corrosion or to purchase rewards from the Skull of Er'inye.
Corin Stallnorth is an ally card from the Throne of the Tides set.
Corrupted Gladiator's Spite was sold by Marshal Gabriel in Boralus and Xander Silberman in Zuldazar during Battle for Azeroth Season 4.
Corrupted Lightning Shield Totems are totems summoned by Lorgus Jett in Blackfathom Deeps.
Corrupted Molten Fury Totems are totems summoned by Lorgus Jett in Blackfathom Deeps.
Corrupted Windfury Totems are totems summoned by Lorgus Jett in Blackfathom Deeps.
Corrupted Green Eggs are located near Jammal'an the Prophet in the Hall of Bones in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar in the Swamp of Sorrows.
Corruption Laden Handguards drop from Festering Rotslime in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar.
Corrupted Grizzlies are bears located in and around Middenvale on Bloodmyst Isle during the draenei heritage questline.
Corrupting Servants are imps located in Nazzivian on Bloodmyst Isle before the Tishamaat.
Corrupted Spiritweaver's Breastplate is sold by Zalgo the Explorer for .
Corrupted Spiritweaver's Mail is a mail set sold by Zalgo the Explorer.
Corrupted Spiritweaver's Leggings are sold by Zalgo the Explorer for .
Corrupted Spiritweaver's Sabatons are sold by Zalgo the Explorer for .
Corrupted Blood of Eranikus was never made available in World of Warcraft Classic: Season of Discovery.
Corrupted Memory of Turalyon is a projection located in Telogrus Rift. Summoned by Xal'atath, it was hunted down by Alleria Windrunner.
Corrupted Heart drops from the Aberrant Deepwalker in Azj-Kahet.
Corrupted Flames are located in the Priory of the Sacred Flame.
Corrupted Felheart is the Tier 1 DPS armor set for Warlocks.
Corrupted Boots, Legs, and Shoulders Set is a quest reward from Anthion's Parting Words (Season of Discovery).
Corrupted Gloves and Belt Set is a quest reward from Just Compensation (Season of Discovery).
Corrupted Helm and Chestpiece Set is a quest reward from Saving the Best for Last (Season of Discovery).
Corrupted Earthen Wristguards drop from the Rampaging Blight in the Rumbling Wastes in the Ringing Deeps.
Corrupted Earthen Wristwraps drop from the Rampaging Blight in the Rumbling Wastes in the Ringing Deeps.
Corrupted Earthen Cuffs drop from the Rampaging Blight in the Rumbling Wastes in the Ringing Deeps.
Corrupted Earthen Binds drop from the Rampaging Blight in the Rumbling Wastes in the Ringing Deeps.
Corruption Sifter's Treads drop from Jix'ak the Crazed in the Maddening Deep in Azj-Kahet.
Corrupted Emerald Eggs are eggs located in the Emerald Nightmare. It hatches into a Rotten Drake.
Corrupted Machinists are skardyn located in the Ritual Hall in the Hall of Awakening during the Awakening the Machine event.
Corrupted Oracles are skardyn located in the Stormrider Barracks in the Rookery.
Corrupted Cranes are cranes located near the Temple of the Jade Serpent in the Jade Forest.
Corruption Parasites are dreadticks located in the Excavation Site 9 delve.

Corruption of the Aspects is a dragon mount that can be purchased for 40,000 Displaced Corrupted Mementos from Torie at the Coreway in Dornogal as part of Horrific Visions Revisited. It is a void-themed recolor of Heart of the Aspects.
Corrupted Sap drops from Void Masses and Void Residue on K'aresh.

Corrupted Granules drop from Void Residues and Void Masses, which are summoned during Void Fused Resin (quest) after striking Void-Tainted Growth in Eco-Dome: Primus on K'aresh. 35 Corrupted Globules need to be gathered to complete the quest.
Corrupted Runelord's Band is available for purchase at the Trading Post for 100 Trader's Tender.
Corrupted Silkweave Doublet is available for purchase at the Trading Post for 90 Trader's Tender.
Corrupted Thorn of the Dream drops at max level during the first phase of Legion Remix and will reward Emerald Nightmare-themed and -level equipment.
Corrupted Manafiends are arcane elementals located in Terrace of Lectures in Algeth'ar Academy.
Corrupted Healing Totems are totems that are summoned by Twilight Storm Menders in the Blackfathom Deeps.
Corruption Resonator is provided by Arcanist Taemin for The Dark Part of the Woods.
Corrupted Squallfins are murlocs located in the Magisters' Park at the road leading to Greengill Coast on the Isle of Quel'Danas during the assault by the Devouring Host.
Corrupted Twilight Cowl is a quest reward from The Missing Magister.

Corrupted Golds are spawned during the Priestess Alun'za encounter at the Shimmering Pinnacle in Atal'Dazar on Heroic and Mythic difficulties. They are untargetable, but their name shows up in the tooltip when mousing over them.
Corrupted Warlocks are blood elves located in Augurs' Terrace in Murder Row.
Corrupted Lantern is looted from the Dark Evil Corrupted Chest of Tormented Darkness aboard the Derelict Legion Vessel.
Corrupted Chestplate of the Crusader is an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Corrupted Regalia of the Crusader.
Corrupted Cloak of the Crusader is an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Corrupted Regalia of the Crusader.
Corrupted Gloves of the Crusader is an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Corrupted Regalia of the Crusader.

Corrupted Cowl of the Crusader is an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Corrupted Regalia of the Crusader.
Corswyn Aseril is a skyborne located in Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.
Council of Dreams is a boss in Amirdrassil, the Dream's Hope.
Cougar Cage Key drops from Galak Maulers in . It opens the cage at Camp E'thok containing the Seared Needles Cougar.
Courage of the White Tiger is a Conduit of the Celestials monk hero talent.
The Council of Dornogal is the ruling council of the earthen of Khaz Algar.

Councilward's Rise overlooks Dornogal from the northeast. It is bordered by Keepers Terrace and Foundation Hall to the southwest, Stoneshaper's Atrium to the south, and Stoneward's Rise and the Oath Gate to the southeast. The Dornogal Drift skyriding race is at the same level to the west, north of Foundation Hall.
Councilward's Signet is provided by Merrix for Stones of Dornogal.
Courier Mission: Ore Recovery is a world quest located at in the Taelloch Mine of Ringing Deeps, associated with two achievements: I Only Need One Trip and For the Collective.
Counter Bardra is an earthen located in Council's Treasury in Dornogal.
Counter Targrin is an earthen located in the Council's Treasury in Dornogal.

Cosmic Oozes are oozes located in Galakrond's Rest in the Dragonblight, in front of Ulduar in the Storm Peaks, and Telogrus Rift. At Galakrond's Rest they spawn while uncovering the Riftwalker Tracks during Walk a Mile in Her Shadows.
The Councilward's Office is the office of Merrix. It is located at the Councilward's Rise in Dornogal.
The Council of Dornogal Commendation is automatically consumed and provides the amount of reputation shown in its tooltip with the Council of Dornogal.
Courier's Dragonriding Spaulders drop from Drahga Shadowburner in Grim Batol.
Coursehares are virmen located at the Emerald Hills Golf Course in the Undermine.
Cosmic Hearthstone drops as bonus loot from Dimensius in Manaforge Omega. It uses the portal-from-below animation that Xal'atath uses in the Intercession cinematic for .

Cosmic Soulsliver drop from Argus the Unmaker in Antorus, the Burning Throne during Legion Remix. Trade 20 of them in to Pythagorus for the Scythe of the Unmaker (cosmetic). ]] Cosmic worms (also called Inchshifters) are a type of worm that consume Void energy in order to grow. They can be found on K'aresh. Odds of their successful integration into the Oasis were projected at less than one percent.

The Council of Oracles was a group of elite K'areshi Oracles who constituted the ruling authority of K'aresh prior to its destruction, and its members guided the K'areshi people through all facets of life. At the onset of the Devouring War it was lead by the High Priest of the Untamed, Salhadaar, but during the war he renounced his position as High Priest and its leadership fell to his confidante the Soul-Scribe. The Council of Oracles' customary gathering place for meetings was in Tazavesh, though its members could request for it to meet elsewhere with the High Priest's approval.
